title: Step data for net1 on a hit's concepts
description: Step 4 (docs/methodology.md, retraining), first of three experiments: the step data net1 learns a hit's concepts from. The hit is the input hit, its decompose output read from its release; as this file now stands, BBRv3's width 7 seed 128 with the window hidden, from exp-controller-seed-search-49. Prepare writes net1's spec on the hit's concepts (experiments/ground.py spec: the estimator's settings, experiments/specs/net1v4.json, with the hit's recovered formulas, along the first basis in which it decomposes, as its LCFs) into concepts.json, with a note of them in concepts.md. The formulas read features over the steps before each step, which a table keeping every 6th step cannot compute, so campaign run --features computes them over every step of each episode and keeps them beside the strided steps. The data is net1 v5's training set (examples/net1_broad.py, set train30: 2,400 links, two conditions each from a broad set of 64, three controllers per link, 30 s episodes, every 6th step kept), as experiments/data-net1-broad-30s.json made it in the project compact was forked from, with the fixed rule from exp-steps-behaviour-rule-8. An episode that fails validation is recorded as failed and left out of the data. At most five cells run at once, beside the seed search's five. Then experiments/concepts-net1.json reads this release.
prepare: uv run python experiments/ground.py spec "$OUT/concepts.json" "$IN/hit"; uv run python examples/net1_broad.py "$OUT/spec-train30" --set train30 --models "$IN/rule/models"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-train30/campaign.json" "$OUT/campaign-train30"
run: mapfile -t F < <(jq -r '.lcfs[]' "$OUT/concepts.json"); uv run expliccit campaign run "$OUT/campaign-train30" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps --steps-stride 6 --features "${F[@]}" || echo "an episode failed; it is recorded as failed and left out of the data"
collect: uv run expliccit campaign status "$OUT/campaign-train30" > "$OUT/status-train30.json"; { cat "$OUT/concepts.md"; echo; echo "| set | status |"; echo "|---|---|"; echo "| train30 | $(jq -c . "$OUT/status-train30.json") |"; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
